goal: Choose the next materially different Foundation setup route after the U-VAT325-DISC field-selection route was parked.
whyNow: Foundation Readiness has consumed the latest Field-Map read-first and parked Configuration Package write-gate decision. The next step must not repeat the same package-card, worksheet or field-selection route and must decide whether a source-backed, different BC surface, future read-first or parked route is best.
businessPurpose: Keep Foundation setup realistic for a customer project while preventing blind UI retries and premature setup writes.
expectedOutput: A compact local route-decision result JSON that selects one next route status: ready-for-readfirst, ready-for-write-gate, parked or rejected.
A nextCase selection that is materially different from the parked U-VAT325-DISC field-selection route.
Explicit no-live/no-write boundary and no VAT, posting, master-data or process-readiness claim.
stopConditions: Stop if the decision would require opening Business Central or running Playwright.
Stop if the proposed route repeats U-VAT325-DISC field selection without a materially new helper, UI insight, official source, different BC surface, different goal or manual approval.
Stop if the proposed route unlocks import, export, validate, apply, Edit in Excel, setup writes or master data writes without a separate gate.
Stop if Configuration Package metadata is treated as VAT setup correctness.

nextCaseOptions.when: Use only if the route decision needs a different read-first surface with visual-state timeline and no package mutation.
Use if official source or local table/field mapping must be clarified before any UI route.
Use only if Foundation setup remains parked but training/handbook master-data route work can continue without process-readiness claims.
